description: This file defines interfaces for an IPC server and client within the Rialto project, including classes IClient and IServer, with methods for managing client connections, sending messages, and integrating with external event loops.

classes.name: IClient
classes.description: Interface representing a connected client, providing methods to query client info, send events, and manage connection state.

classes.name: IServer
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC server capable of accepting connections, managing clients, and integrating with event loops.

methods.name: addSocket
methods.description: Creates a listening socket for incoming client connections, with optional callbacks for connection events.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Creates a client object from a socket file descriptor and adds it to the server, with optional disconnection callback.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns an external file descriptor for event loop integration.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for I/O events or a timeout, blocking until activity occurs or timeout expires.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes incoming connections and data, handling server I/O.
